description: This Java class 'TbEntityDataSubCtx' manages entity data subscriptions, handling data fetching, WebSocket message sending, and subscription updates within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbEntityDataSubCtx
classes.description: Manages entity data subscriptions, handles data updates, and communicates via WebSocket within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches data and updates latest timestamp data.

methods.name: sendWsMsg
methods.description: Sends WebSocket message based on subscription update and key type.

methods.name: getCurrentAggregation
methods.description: Returns the current data aggregation method.

methods.name: sendLatestWsMsg
methods.description: Sends latest value WebSocket message for an entity.

methods.name: sendTsWsMsg
methods.description: Sends time series WebSocket message for an entity.

methods.name: getDataForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific entity.

methods.name: getLatestTsValuesForEntity
methods.description: Gets latest timestamped values for an entity.

methods.name: updateLatestTsData
methods.description: Updates internal latest timestamp data from current data.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs subscription data update, manages subscription lifecycle, and sends update messages.

methods.name: setCurrentCmd
methods.description: Sets current command objects for data subscription.

methods.name: buildEntityDataQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns the entity data query.
